name: Dating Different Races
overview: Scripture teaches that while God created all nations from one blood and has ordained boundaries for their habitation, the unity of believers in Christ transcends ethnic distinctions, as there is neither Jew nor Greek in Him. Old Testament commands, such as Isaac's instruction to Jacob to avoid marrying Canaanite women, reflect God's concern for covenant faithfulness rather than racial separation. Ultimately, marriage is honored by God when it is pure and faithful, emphasizing holiness over ethnic considerations.
